name: ClassPro Ultimate
short_description: A professional classroom management tool with AI seating chart optimization and smartboard integration.
full_description: ClassPro Ultimate is the ultimate pedagogical suite designed for modern educators. Streamline your classroom administration, keep track of student participation with a behavior score-tracker, and automatically generate optimized classroom seating maps with Gemini AI and Simulated Annealing algorithms. ClassPro features smartboard-optimized landscape views, group generators, pedagogical note-keeping, and real-time synchronization. Perfect for secondary schools, higher education, or elementary classrooms looking to create structural harmony and optimize peer learning networks.
